summary: Client settings singleton of ls::SoundOcclusionSystem: two config files loaded by ls::SoundOcclusionHelper::LoadSettingsConfig (Sound/SoundOcclusionSchedulerConfig.lsf and Sound/SoundOcclusionMaterialConfig.lsf, both ls::FileFormatIO objects with a virtual table and a Path), then entity lists/sets used by the occlusion scheduler. Toolkit (GameEngine.dll) names the parts; the Toolkit build is 16 bytes larger (each config there has an extra dword after its Path), the live layout below follows the samples.

SoundOcclusionRaycast member names: the FixedString names visited in Raycast::Visit live in GameEngine.dll globals that the fixedstrings tool did not resolve; no bg3.exe twin was found.
